summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Home page toggle functionality and video playback fix. The WebM+MP4 dual-source approach successfully resolved the headless Chromium codec issue. All 7 videos in the FilmStrip section now load and play correctly with readyState=4 (HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA). NO 'DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS' errors detected. Toggle functionality (Lato Pubblico ↔ Lato Segreto) works flawlessly: card image crossfade, atmosphere overlay, hero text changes, video switching (pub↔sec), and analytics tracking all functioning correctly. No page reload, no scroll jump, no horizontal overflow on any device. Responsive design verified on desktop (1920x1080), tablet (640x844), and mobile (390x844). All regression tests passed: filters, profile navigation, no JavaScript errors.
